instructions:
1. Sit on the seat and adjust its height so your knees have a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
2. Place your feet on the pedals and grip the handles.
3. Drive the pedals as fast as possible while pushing and pulling the handles hard in rhythm with your legs.
4. Keep your torso upright and core braced throughout.
5. Hold maximum effort for the set time, then ease off.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive explosively with both arms and legs to reach top speed.
2. Brace your core hard to keep your torso stable during the sprint.
3. Use short, sharp breaths to sustain the effort.
4. Stay seated and avoid bouncing on the seat.
name: Assault AirBike Sprint Speed

instructions:
1. Stand about 60 cm in front of a bench or box facing away from it.
2. Rest the top of your back foot on the bench and hold a stable support with one hand for balance.
3. Keep your chest upright and your front foot flat on the floor.
4. Lower by bending your front knee and hip until your back knee is near the floor.
5. Drive through your front heel to stand back up, then switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Use the support only for balance, not to pull yourself up.
2. Keep your front shin near vertical to load the quads and glutes.
3. Keep your hips square to avoid leaning to one side.
4. Control the descent and pause briefly at the bottom.
name: Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions:
1. Kneel on the platform pad of an assisted chin-up machine.
2. Grasp the handles with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart.
3. Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
4. Lower under control until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body as you pull.
2. Set the assistance so you can complete clean reps with full range.
3. Pull with your back and biceps rather than swinging.
4. Exhale as you pull up and inhale as you lower.
name: Assisted close grip underhand chin up

instructions:
1. Kneel on the platform pad of an assisted chin-up machine.
2. Grasp the parallel handles with palms facing each other, about shoulder-width apart.
3. Pull your body upward until your chin clears the handles.
4. Lower under control until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows tracking close to your body as you pull.
2. Set the assistance so you can complete clean reps with full range.
3. Drive your elbows down to lead with your back muscles.
4. Exhale as you pull up and inhale as you lower.
name: Assisted parallel close grip pull up

instructions:
1. Stand on one leg and hold a sturdy support with both hands for balance.
2. Extend the other leg straight forward and keep it off the floor.
3. Bend the standing hip and knee to lower slowly, keeping your chest up and the free leg straight.
4. Descend until your glutes are near your heel.
5. Push through the heel to stand back up, switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lower under control and do not collapse at the bottom.
2. Keep the free leg straight and roughly parallel to the floor.
3. Use the support only for balance, not to pull yourself up.
4. Keep weight on the mid-foot and heel of the working leg.
name: Assisted Pistol Squats
